prompt: Compose an original complete 60-second instrumental cue for syncopated stop-motion product reveal. Instruments: muted guitar, elastic bass, dry drums. 112 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a rising fourth followed by a descending step. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: An upbeat and energetic electronic pop track featuring a driving beat, prominent synth bassline, and catchy synth melodies. The production is clean and modern, creating a positive and dynamic atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首欢快且充满活力的电子流行音乐，具有强劲的节拍、突出的合成器低音线和抓耳的合成器旋律。制作干净现代，营造出积极动感的氛围。
